title: Takeoff — Genève LSGG
description: Helvetic Airways E190 ready for departure from runway 23. Live METAR. Cleared for immediate takeoff. Mountains ahead.
author: Markus Leutwyler

Helvetic, taxi to holding point runway two three via Foxtrot and November

atcClearances.atc: Helvetic, line up and wait runway two three, one departure ahead
Helvetic, wind two three zero at ten, runway two three, cleared for takeoff

debrief: Was the takeoff roll smooth on runway 23?
Did you maintain runway heading until 1000ft AGL?
Lake Geneva appeared off the right — did you see it?
Mont Blanc is visible at 12 o'clock — how clear was it?
